facts.subject: src/sysdolphin/baselib/hsd_3B27.c
facts.version_note: updated_at is the frozen fact version exposed by this API.
facts.value: Asynchronous requests enter with an HSD card context and operation-specific filenames, indices, buffers, ranges, and callbacks. The queue wrappers write these into the command slot selected by hsd_804D7994, while hsd_804D7990 identifies the consumer position; accepted requests advance the producer index modulo 32. Separately, an 18-byte banner and icon descriptor is copied into the HSD card context and passed to hsd_803AC340, whose returned byte count is cached in that context.
facts.reason: TU independent review: inherited range terminology remains inconsistent with deferred producer/consumer meanings; narrow replacement required.
